# JadeMediaPro

> JadeMediaPro is a creative digital agency serving Montréal, Ottawa and Lagos, delivering branding, web and mobile development, video production, motion graphics and digital marketing.

JadeMediaPro partners with growing brands to build identity systems, high-converting websites and content that performs. The site is available in English and Canadian French.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the agency, services and featured work.
- [About](/about): Mission, vision, values and community work.
- [Services](/services): Branding, design, strategy, marketing, motion graphics, web and mobile development, plus FAQs.
- [Projects](/projects): Case studies and client results.
- [Process](/process): Step-by-step workflow for animation, branding, marketing and web projects.
- [Team](/team): The people behind JadeMediaPro and career opportunities.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on branding, design, marketing and technology.
- [Contact](/contact): Project enquiry form and booking details.
